from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g., 《判决文书 1》)")
    stated_cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The explicit cause of action stated in the document (案由)")
    legal_domain: str = Field(description="The broad legal domain, e.g., 'Civil', 'Administrative', 'Special Procedure'")
    parties_relationship: str = Field(description="Description of the relationship between parties, e.g., 'Family', 'Neighbor', 'Citizen vs Gov'")
    core_dispute_subject: str = Field(description="The core subject matter of the dispute, e.g., 'Divorce Property', 'Tort Damages', 'Ownership'")
    administrative_body: str | None = Field(None, description="Name of the administrative body involved in administrative cases")
    administrative_act_type: str | None = Field(None, description="Type of administrative act if applicable, e.g., 'Demolition', 'Penalty', 'Compensation'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
